# `token_graduations`

<!-- Generated by `nadfun-export` from src/nadfun_export/tables.py. Do not edit. -->

One row per token that left its bonding curve (one CurveGraduate event).

- Files: [`token_graduations.csv`](token_graduations.csv), [`token_graduations.json`](token_graduations.json)
- Schemas: [`schema.json`](schema.json) (Frictionless Table Schema), [`json-schema.json`](json-schema.json) (JSON Schema 2020-12 for the JSON file)
- Primary key: (`chain`, `token_address`)
- Row order: (`chain`, `block_number`, `log_index`), ascending. Chronological, so new rows are appended at the end.
- Foreign key: (chain, token_address) → [`tokens`](../tokens/README.md) (chain, token_address)

Conventions (nulls, numbers, timestamps) are in [docs/conventions.md](../../docs/conventions.md).

| column | type | nullable | unit | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chain` | string (enum) | no |  | Chain the event was observed on. Values: `monad`. |
| `token_address` | address | no |  | Graduated token. Joins to `tokens` on (chain, token_address). |
| `launchpad` | string (enum) | no |  | Launchpad that emitted the event. Values: `nadfun`. |
| `contract_address` | address | no |  | Bonding-curve contract that emitted the event. |
| `pool_address` | address | yes |  | Pool address recorded in the graduation event. |
| `graduated_at` | timestamp `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` | yes | UTC | Timestamp of the block containing the graduation event. |
| `block_number` | integer | no |  | Block containing the event. |
| `tx_hash` | tx hash | no |  | Transaction containing the event. |
| `log_index` | integer | no |  | Position of the event log within its block. |
